verdict.rationale: Browser Use Cloud exposes a hosted, API-key-authenticated REST API at api.browser-use.com/api/v4 with a documented 'Create Run' POST endpoint. Results come back as `run.result`, and runs can be monitored by polling `runs.events()` with a cursor. Browsers are managed in the cloud, with stealth, proxies and CAPTCHA solving on by default, so the agent never runs a browser itself. Polling alone satisfies the story; no webhook delivery is documented. missing for 10: documented webhook callbacks for run completion, independent hands-on corroboration of the hosted run/poll flow

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can submit a browser task over a hosted HTTP API and receive the result by polling or webhook, without managing any browser myself

citations.quote: Poll `runs.events()` with the previous cursor to receive only new events
Give a high-accuracy browser agent a goal and get the result.
Every cloud browser session runs in a hardened Chromium fork with stealth enabled by default — no configuration needed.
